thread:
morgan (prod): Quick sync: we need to lock the Q2 scope for reserved pools. Sales pushing for predictable burst billing; engineering wants a minimal, testable MVP. Can we decide today?

devon (eng): My recommendation: MVP = per-tenant reserved pools + per-period burst budget + autoscale-out (90s cooldown) + fallback to shared pool when exhausted. No carryover. Keeps control-plane simple.

nina (eng-platform): Observability must be first-class for this. Required metrics: tenant.burst_tokens, reserve_usage_pct, queued_requests_by_tenant. Also add tenant_id tag to traces so we can link spikes to calls. Billing export must include burst_tokens_used and overage_flag.

raj (oncall): Oncall needs guardrails. Proposed alert: spill_count > 5 for same tenant within 10m -> page. Also we need a one-command eviction CLI and a short runbook.

sam (solutions): Contracts: agree on no carryover for MVP. We can market a "burst bank" premium later. Pricing tiers: small/medium/large burst blocks. I'll draft language.

morgan (prod): Tradeoffs: soft-spill + priority queuing is useful but large. Proposal: ship minimal path, put soft-spill behind a feature flag for pilot customers only. Agree?

devon (eng): Agree, but the feature gate must include limits so pilots can't starve others. We'll also need a config surfaced in console to enable/disable per-tenant.

nina (eng-platform): I'll implement metrics + billing export and the feature flag hook. ETA ~8 business days. I'll also add histogram of burst_token_consumption to help pricing decisions.

raj (oncall): Once metrics are in, I'll write alert queries and schedule an eviction drill. Preferred window: Wed 02:00 UTC (low traffic).

elaine (legal): I'll review contract language from sam. Need explicit wording: "no burst carryover," "soft-spill is opt-in for pilot customers only," and clauses for overage billing.

deploy-bot: Note: next possible deploy window Tue 03/05 22:00 UTC. Reserve via the regular form.

morgan (prod): Launch gates (initial):
  1) Metrics + tenant tracing in prod
  2) Billing export CSV with burst columns
  3) Canary with 2 pilot customers behind flag
  4) Autoscale perf tests passing at 90s cooldown and scale step validated
  5) Eviction CLI, runbook and successful oncall drill
  6) Pricing page + contract language published
Anything to add?

sam (solutions): Add migration docs for customers moving from shared -> reserved pools and a FAQ for behavior during exhaustion.

devon (eng): Autoscale draft config (baseline):
```
policy:
  cooldown: 90s
  scale_step: 1_pool
  max_scale: 4_pools
  max_burst_ratio: 3.0
  fallback: shared_pool
```
I'll run load tests and post results in #eng-releases.

nina (eng-platform): Metrics I'll add: tenant_headroom_pct, burst_tokens_consumed, spill_count, fallback_switch_count. I'll also wire billing CSV export to BigQuery.

raj (oncall): After metrics are live, I will create the alert playbook and coordinate the drill date.

morgan (prod): Actions: devon (autoscale + perf), nina (metrics + export + flag hook), sam (pricing + pilot outreach + docs), elaine (contract review), raj (drill + runbook). Target: canary by 03/22. If anyone has blockers call it out now. :thumbsup:
